title: Manaraq naceq runakunaq Promesa nisqa
intro: Tukuy sonqoyoq almaqa manaraq wawa chayamushaqtinmi ch’uya promesata ruwarqan. Kay siqiq willakuyninqa huk santuarioq perqankuna ukhupin mast’arikun, chaypin devoción tupan Diospa chaskiyninwan. ¿Pitaq kay Allahpa kamachin?
clues: Huk solemne promesa ruwarqani manaraq naceq wawayta Allahpa serviyninman dedicanaypaq.
Wachakuchkaptiymi admirakurqani warmi wawa kasqanmanta, qari wawata suyachkaptiypas.
Wawaytaqa Maryam sutiwanmi suticharqani, chay sutiqa qawachinmi devocionta hinaspa serviyta.
Wawaypaqpas mirayninkunapaqpas Allahpa amachaynintan maskharqani ñakasqa Satanasmanta.
Wawaytaqa Señormi chaskirqan, hinaspan santuariopi Profeta Zakariyaq qhawariyninman churarqan.

outcome.label: Tukusqa
options: Wawantaqa chaskirqankun, hinaspan Profeta Zakariyaq qhawariyninman churarqanku
Payqa qespichisqa karqan huk tirano castigomanta
outcome.answer: Wawantaqa chaskirqankun, hinaspan Profeta Zakariyaq qhawariyninman churarqanku

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
